reference_sources.title: Obsidian Bases syntax
reference_sources.observation: Native .base definitions are YAML documents with top-level filters, formulas, properties and views; views can declare filters, order, grouping and limits.

reference_sources.title: Obsidian Bases overview
reference_sources.observation: Bases are database-like views over Markdown properties and files, and can be stored in .base files or embedded in Markdown.

source_tree_definition: SHA-256 over sorted tracked and untracked paths plus a NUL separator, file bytes and a trailing NUL separator for each path, excluding .agents, .git, node_modules, .fallow, dist and out.

implemented: Added a bounded native YAML .base adapter alongside the existing version-1 JSON grammar, retaining unknown source fields and the exact original YAML source for read-only encoding.
Normalized supported native and/or/not comparison filters, top-level plus view formulas, order, groupBy and limit fields into the platform-neutral Bases evaluator.
Added visible invalid-filter/invalid-source issue reporting and prevented unsupported native filters or executable expressions from being partially evaluated or executed.
Added a pinned native YAML fixture, focused Bun test command and documentation for the pure evaluator/adapter boundary that a future Expo host can reuse.
limitations: Full Obsidian formula/filter semantics, all YAML dialect constructs, embedded Markdown base blocks and plugin-provided view layouts are not implemented by the bounded adapter.
Reference Obsidian reopen comparisons, cross-platform visible validation and structured native-YAML editing remain pending; the current native path is read-only and source-authoritative.
